info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Banking Accounts Statements-v1-spec
info.description: The Banking Account Statements Retrieval API enables users to access detailed statements for their banking accounts. This endpoint allows consumers, such as banking applications and financial service providers, to retrieve essential account information, including transaction history and balances. With a focus on providing accurate and timely data, the API supports various use cases such as account monitoring and financial planning. It empowers users to manage their finances effectively by providing easy access to their statements.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of account statements.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch their account statements. Account statements provide a detailed overview of transactions and balance over a specified period.

requestBody.description: Retrieve account statements based on the specified criteria. This request body should contain the necessary information required to filter and retrieve the desired statements in JSON format.
